title: Puppy with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="eyeShine" cx="35%" cy="35%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#aaddff"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2255aa"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="24" ry="18" fill="#d4933a"/>
  <!-- Chest fluff -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="13" ry="12" fill="#f5e0b8"/>
  <!-- Back legs -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="92" rx="9" ry="6" fill="#c4842e"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="92" rx="9" ry="6" fill="#c4842e"/>
  <!-- Front legs -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="93" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#e0a850"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="93" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#e0a850"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="45" rx="28" ry="25" fill="#d4933a"/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx="22" cy="35" rx="10" ry="16" fill="#a86e22" transform="rotate(-20 22 35)"/>
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="35" rx="10" ry="16" fill="#a86e22" transform="rotate(20 78 35)"/>
  <ellipse cx="23" cy="35" rx="6" ry="11" fill="#e8b06a" transform="rotate(-20 23 35)"/>
  <ellipse cx="77" cy="35" rx="6" ry="11" fill="#e8b06a" transform="rotate(20 77 35)"/>
  <!-- Muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="56" rx="16" ry="12" fill="#f5e0b8"/>
  <!-- Sparkly eyes -->
  <circle cx="39" cy="43" r="7" fill="url(#eyeShine)"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="43" r="7" fill="url(#eyeShine)"/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx="37" cy="41" r="2.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="41" r="2.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="41.5" cy="45.5" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="63.5" cy="45.5" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="53" rx="5" ry="3.5" fill="#3a2a1a"/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M46 57 Q50 62 54 57" fill="none" stroke="#8a5a2a" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Tongue -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="63" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#ff7a8a"/>
  <path d="M50 60 L50 63" stroke="#dd5566" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Eyebrows -->
  <path d="M33 37 Q37 34 43 36" fill="none" stroke="#a86e22" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M57 36 Q63 34 67 37" fill="none" stroke="#a86e22" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Collar -->
  <rect x="33" y="66" width="34" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#e84545"/>
  <!-- Tag -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="72" r="3.5" fill="#ffd700"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="72" r="2" fill="#ffec80"/>
  <!-- Sparkles around eyes -->
  <path d="M27 27 L29 31 L33 32 L29 33 L27 37 L25 33 L21 32 L25 31 Z" fill="#fff8b0"/>
  <path d="M73 27 L75 31 L79 32 L75 33 L73 37 L71 33 L67 32 L71 31 Z" fill="#fff8b0"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="47" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="47" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
</svg>
